title: Invisible Explosive Overlay
description: Removes texture of Crystals, Creepers etc.....
body:
What this pack does?:
---------------------
this pack provides visual advantage by removing following textures: 
- end_crystal
- creeper
- wind_charge
- minecart
- explosion particles (particle produced by explosion)
- gust particles (particle produced by wind_charge)
- generic particles (particle produced by fire, explosions, death etc,,,,)

this pack is designed for: 
- Vanilla PvP
- Creeper PvP
- Mace PvP
- Cart PvP
